_comment: usg-radius as an EAP home server, reached directly by the NAS and (for the usg.test realm) through the usg-radius proxy. EAP-TLS: validates its own MS-MPPE key emission, the TLS 1.3 exporter labels, and CRL revocation checking of supplicant certificates (certs/ca.crl revokes client-usg-revoked) against eapol_test. EAP-TEAP (RFC 9930): the same server certificate through eap.teap_tls without a client certificate; the peer authenticates with Basic-Password-Auth inside the tunnel (user teapuser@usg.test), which proves the Crypto-Binding TLV, the IMCK/CMK/MSK key schedule and the MS-MPPE keys against eapol_test.
